steps.name: prepare_command
command:
import hashlib,importlib.metadata as m,json,pathlib,urllib.request
R=pathlib.Path("/workspace-SR003.nfs2/ARG-GNN")
pin=json.loads((R/"configs/official_argmix_native_environment_v1/approved-connection-pool-source-build-v1.json").read_text())
P=R/pin["candidate_prefix"]
import sys
assert pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()==P.resolve()
for name,expected in pin["build_backend"]["packages"].items():
    d=m.distribution(name); records={}
    assert d.version==expected["version"],"backend version drift: "+name
    for f in d.files or []:
        p=d.locate_file(f).resolve()
        if (p.suffix==".py" or p.name in {"METADATA","WHEEL","RECORD","entry_points.txt"}) and p.is_file():
            p.relative_to(P)
            records[str(p.relative_to(P))]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    raw=json.dumps(records,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==expected["fingerprint_sha256"],"backend file drift: "+name
work=R/pin["workspace"];work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ("tmp","cache","logs","wheels"): (work/name).mkdir()
data=urllib.request.urlopen(pin["source_artifact"]["url"],timeout=30).read()
assert len(data)==pin["source_artifact"]["bytes"]
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==pin["source_artifact"]["sha256"]
(work/pin["source_artifact"]["filename"]).write_bytes(data)
(work/"prebuild-frozen-pin.json").write_text(json.dumps(pin,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":"source_bytes_and_backend_fingerprints_verified_no_source_execution",
 "source_sha256":pin["source_artifact"]["sha256"],"workspace":str(work)}))

backend_pins.origin: implicit PEP517 setuptools legacy route; archive has no pyproject.toml
backend_pins.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 of compact sort_keys JSON mapping candidate-prefix-relative installed .py plus METADATA/WHEEL/RECORD/entry_points.txt file names to SHA256; pyc excluded; every file must remain inside candidate prefix
